name: Minecraft (Paper)
author: raven
description: Minecraft Java server running Paper. Supports Vanilla, Paper, and Spigot.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Paper Installation Script

apt update
apt install -y curl jq

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
    VERSION="latest"
fi

if [ -z "${BUILD}" ]; then
    BUILD="latest"
fi

if [ -z "${SERVER_JAR}" ]; then
    SERVER_JAR="server.jar"
fi

# Resolve the latest build number if requested
if [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
    BUILD=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}/builds | jq -r '.builds[-1].build')
fi

# Download the Paper jar
curl -o ${SERVER_JAR} https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}/downloads/paper-${VERSION}-${BUILD}.jar

# Accept the EULA so the server can start
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Paper ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} downloaded"

variables.name: Server Jar
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft to install (e.g. 1.20.4, latest).

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Paper build to install (latest or a specific build number).
